units.mse: coordinate units^2 for the spacing, (coordinate units/s)^2 for the speed
units.mae: coordinate units for the spacing, coordinate units/s for the speed
units.mape_percent: percent (samples with a zero measurement skipped and counted)
units.r2: dimensionless, 1 - SS_res/SS_tot about the measured mean
units.scale_s: coordinate units (pooled std of all measured s of the run)
units.scale_v: coordinate units/s (pooled std of all measured v of the run)

cv_scheme.training: all remaining events of the same run
cv_scheme.prediction: pure forward simulation of the held-out event from its first measured (s, v) with the measured lv series; the held-out event is never used to fit
per_fold_metrics: spacing/speed mse, rmse, mae, mape_percent, r2
cv_scheme.aggregation: equal weight mean over the feasible folds for every error metric (mse/rmse/mae/mape); violation counts summed; r2 rebuilt on the pooled residuals (1 - sum SS_res / sum SS_tot, each fold about its own mean)

M1.note: one bounded least-squares fit (no budget parameter)

M2.note: multi-start Nelder-Mead; the module requires at least 11 starts

budgets.note: the brief allows the global methods (GA/PSO/M5 multi-start) to run at half budget inside the cross-validation; the final retrain always uses the full budget
